Built from the research in the session scratchpad by build2/make_more.py. Copyrighted material is fetched from its address when the case is loaded and never stored here; files/ holds only public-domain text and pictures and the Workbench's own transcriptions. Every value keeps its quote and locator; inferences are unverified claims or leads.
